text: The AI factory's criteria library v1 (GDD 05 §5.4, Round B1). One library, two uses (B1Q1): FITNESS, what the GA selects on (hx fitness, end-of-game forms from SimMetrics), and DECISIONS, what a profile's utility process weighs through its mask (SimCriteria, decision-time forms from a player's observation). Every value is in [0, 1] except result (-1 to 1) and margin (-1 to 1). 'kinds' lists the run kinds a criterion applies to; 'decision' says whether a decision-time form exists yet.

result.text: Win 1, draw 0, loss 0, forfeit -1. A turn-limit draw scores as a loss for both sides (B1Q3); leaving the game scores below a loss (B1Q4).

speed.text: On a win only: 1 - turns / turn cap.

margin.text: Battle: (own VP - best opponent VP) / both. Overworld: the same over worth (banked Value plus the Value of squads held). Tiebreak weight only.

value_efficiency.text: Value destroyed / (destroyed + lost), counting only enemy-player victims (B1Q7). No fighting = 0.5. Overworld runs use the battles inside them.

force_ratio.text: Mean over turns of own force / (own + enemy force). Overworld: the enemy force the player can see; battles: the other sides' living Value.

objective_control.text: Battle: own share of zone-held ticks. Overworld: own share of feature-turns held. Nobody held anything = 0.5.

economy.text: Own share of Value earned (earned, not banked: hoarding doesn't pay, B1Q7). Nobody earned = 0.5.

commander_safety.text: Commanders alive at the end / at the start. Decision time: the weakest own commander's army / (army + hostile Value near it).

tempo.text: 1 - own first capture turn / turns (0 if never). Low weight; also a schedule condition.

pressure.text: (enemy Morale fraying+broken share - own share + 1) / 2: always own versus enemy, never own alone (R4Q4). Decision time needs the forecast (sw-884.3).

descriptors.aggression: Overworld: battles fought per turn. Battle: Value destroyed / the enemy's starting force.
descriptors.expansion: Overworld: fog revealed share x objective control. Battle: objective control.
descriptors.caution: 1 - Value lost / own starting force (battles; overworld uses the battles inside it).
